## Topic:

Relationships between physical activity and BMI using the NHANES dataset. - Physical activity will be looked as both a binary variable (yes/no) and an ordinal variable (numbers of days exercised per week) - BMI will be looked as both continuous and categorical (WHO definitions)

Shiny App: maybe an interactive graph that toggles between the following options for X and Y, and includes possibility of faceting by gender or age category - X: PA binary (PhysActive) or number of days per week (PhysActiveDays) - Y: BMI categorical (BMI_WHO), BMI continuous (BMI) - Z: gender

# Loading dataset

```{r}
library(NHANES)
library(ggplot2)
data("NHANES")

#names(NHANES)
#head(NHANES)
str(NHANES)
#summary(NHANES)
```

# 1 - PHYSICAL ACTIVITY BINARY AND BMI CONTINUOUS

```{r}
df <- NHANES |> 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(PhysActive), !is.na(BMI))

#Boxplots yes/no - BMI continuous
ggplot(df, aes(x = PhysActive, y = BMI, fill = PhysActive)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "BMI by Physical Activity Status")

#Facets by gender - BMI continuous
ggplot(df, aes(x = PhysActive, y = BMI, fill = PhysActive)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~ Gender) +
  labs(title = "BMI by Physical Activity, Stratified by Gender")
```

#2 - PHYSICAL ACTIVITY BINARY AND BMI CATEGORICAL

```{r}
df <- NHANES |> 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(PhysActive), !is.na(BMI_WHO))

#Bar plot
ggplot(df, aes(x = BMI_WHO, fill = PhysActive)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "BMI Category Distribution by Physical Activity",
       x = "BMI Category", y = "Count")

#Stacked bar plot
ggplot(df, aes(x = BMI_WHO, fill = PhysActive)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(title = "Proportion of BMI Categories by Physical Activity",
       x = "BMI Category", y = "Proportion")

#Bar plot by gender
ggplot(df, aes(x = BMI_WHO, fill = PhysActive)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~ Gender) +
  labs(title = "BMI Category by Physical Activity, Stratified by Gender")

#Stacked bar plot by gender
ggplot(df, aes(x = BMI_WHO, fill = PhysActive)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  facet_wrap(~ Gender) +
  labs(title = "Proportion of BMI Categories by Physical Activity",
       x = "BMI Category", y = "Proportion")
```

#3 - PHYSICAL ACTIVITY DAYS AND BMI

```{r, warning=FALSE}
df <- NHANES |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(PhysActiveDays), !is.na(BMI))

#Boxplots
df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(PhysActiveDays), y = BMI, fill = factor(PhysActiveDays))) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "BMI by Number of Physically Active Days per Week",
    x = "Physically Active Days (0–7)",
    y = "BMI"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  guides(fill = "none")

#Boxplots by gender
df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(PhysActiveDays), 
             y = BMI, 
             fill = factor(PhysActiveDays))) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~ Gender) +
  labs(
    title = "BMI by Physical Activity Days per Week, Stratified by Gender",
    x = "Physical Activity Days (0–7)",
    y = "BMI"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  guides(fill = "none")
```

#4 - PHYSICAL ACTIVITY DAYS AND BMI CATEGORICAL

```{r, warning=FALSE}
df <- NHANES |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(PhysActiveDays), !is.na(BMI_WHO))

# Bar plot: BMI categories by number of active days
ggplot(df, aes(x = factor(PhysActiveDays), fill = BMI_WHO)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "BMI Categories by Number of Physically Active Days per Week",
    x = "Physically Active Days per Week (0–7)",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "BMI Category (WHO)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Stacked proportion plot: BMI categories by active days
ggplot(df, aes(x = factor(PhysActiveDays), fill = BMI_WHO)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of BMI Categories by Number of Physically Active Days",
    x = "Physically Active Days per Week (0–7)",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "BMI Category (WHO)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Bar plot stratified by gender
ggplot(df, aes(x = factor(PhysActiveDays), fill = BMI_WHO)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~ Gender) +
  labs(
    title = "BMI Categories by Active Days, Stratified by Gender",
    x = "Physically Active Days per Week (0–7)",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "BMI Category (WHO)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Stacked proportion plot stratified by gender
ggplot(df, aes(x = factor(PhysActiveDays), fill = BMI_WHO)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  facet_wrap(~ Gender) +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of BMI Categories by Active Days, Stratified by Gender",
    x = "Physically Active Days per Week (0–7)",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "BMI Category (WHO)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
